violations.description: General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment *, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. - This facility operates special events such as wedding receptions and makes brick oven pizzas in an open air environment. The structure that is used is a timber framed structure that has a roof and two walls, the other two sides are open and not protected from insect, rodent, or vermin. There are signs of bird feces on the exposed rafters. At the time of inspection there was a cat in the rafters and walking around on top of countertops. There were also 2 pigs that got out of their pen and were in the structure rooting around.
